literature_summary: Canonical NKX2-1 binding at the SFTPC promoter drives surfactant protein C expression in alveolar type 2 cells; established by Bohinski et al. 1994 and many follow-ups.
NKX2-1 binds the SFTPB promoter and is required for surfactant B expression; canonical alveolar target.
NKX2-1 contributes to SCGB1A1 (CC10/CCSP) regulation in club/secretory cells; airway-axis target.
NKX2-1 binds the ABCA3 regulatory region; alveolar lipid transporter for surfactant lamellar bodies.
Reciprocal regulation between NKX2-1 and SOX2 has been proposed in lung-development reviews; direct binding evidence is limited to mouse loss-of-function inference.
NKX2-1 is co-expressed with SOX9 in distal tip progenitors; direct regulatory relationship is mostly inferred from mouse genetics.
FOXA2 cooperates with NKX2-1 in lung epithelial gene regulation; direct binding documented in mouse but not human ChIP.
SOX2 expression precedes basal-cell KRT5 expression in airway development; relationship inferred mostly from mouse and ESC-derived organoid work.
SOX2 and TP63 cooperatively specify basal-cell identity; relationship from mouse and human organoid studies.
SOX2 is upstream of secretory-cell programs including MUC5B; mouse-derived relationship.
SOX9+ distal tip cells give rise to AT2 cells expressing SFTPC; lineage tracing in mouse and inferred in human via fetal scRNA-seq.
SOX9 and ID2 co-mark distal tip cells; relationship is co-expression rather than confirmed direct regulation.
Beta-catenin (CTNNB1) drives AXIN2 expression as a canonical WNT pathway target via TCF/LEF binding.
Canonical WNT target with feedback regulation; LEF1 is the DNA-binding partner that beta-catenin activates.
BMP signaling activates SMAD1/5/8 which drive ID1 expression; canonical BMP target.
SMAD1 also activates ID2 in BMP-responsive cells.
GLI2 (the SHH-pathway effector) drives PTCH1 transcription; canonical SHH target with feedback regulation.
GLI2 transcriptionally upregulates GLI1 in the SHH feedback loop.
